Principles of Macroevolution
¨Developmental Genes and Macroevolution
¤Genes can bring about radical changes in body shapes and organs.
¤Gene expression can influence development
  nA change in gene expression could stop a developmental process or continue it beyond its normal time.
  nUsing modern technology, researchers discovered genes whose differential expression can bring about changes in body shapes and organs.
    nPax6in eye development
    nTbx5in limb development
    nHoxgenes in development of overall shape
explanation: Developmental genes play a key role in macroevolution because they control the timing and pattern of animal development. Changes in gene expression can cause radical alterations in body shape and organ structures by halting a developmental pathway early or extending it past its normal duration. Modern research has identified key regulatory genes whose differential expression drives these structural changes, including Pax6 (essential for eye development), Tbx5 (critical for limb development), and Hox genes (which orchestrate the overall developmental body shape in all animals).

questions.q: Which developmental gene is specifically associated with eye development based on the notes?
questions.exp: The notes state that Pax6 is involved in eye development, while Tbx5 is involved in limb development and Hox genes direct overall shape.

questions.q: How can changes in developmental gene expression lead to radical changes in body shapes?
opts: By increasing the rate of physical erosion in the environment
By stopping a developmental process early or continuing it beyond its normal time
By forcing organisms to enter genetic equilibrium
By preventing any genetic mutations from occurring
questions.exp: The notes explain that gene expression can influence development: changes can stop a process or continue it beyond its normal timeframe, modifying organs and body shapes.
